---
title: "Build, approve and publish an annual CVD report"
description: "Operate the controlled three-step annual-report workflow."
manual-review-status: not-reviewed
---

::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--technical}
Technical Manual
:::

## Before Step 1

Confirm the report year, event release, mortality release and next report
version. Create the two analyst-owned year files:

```text
scripts/stata/reporting/annual/YYYY/bnr_report_annual_YYYY_interpretation.do
scripts/stata/reporting/annual/YYYY/bnr_report_annual_YYYY_focus.do
```

The standard report uses approved public releases. The Focus On module is
analyst-owned and must use inputs appropriate to its approved purpose.

The interpretation file also owns the three concise, year-specific **Key
messages** used by the public-health update. Update those messages from the
reviewed annual results; do not hard-code a report year or headline value in
the reusable appendix template.

## Step 1: Build the candidate

Choose **User > BNR > Annual CVD report > Step 1: Build annual report candidate**.
Enter the report year, both source releases and report version. Confirm that the
private candidate contains exactly five payload files:

- the versioned annual-report PDF;
- the versioned one-page public-health-update PDF;
- `index.qmd` for the annual report;
- `public_health_update.qmd` for the companion product; and
- `report.yml` for the package.

The update is first composed as the final page of the annual report. The
controlled Python helper extracts that exact page, replaces its annual running
furniture with compact standalone furniture, and verifies that it remains one
page. The helper does not read surveillance data or alter the page's analytical
content.

Review both PDFs and both landing pages. In particular, confirm that the final
annual-report page and the standalone update contain the same cards, graph and
Key messages, and that the displayed year follows the requested report year.
Do not approve until the complete five-file candidate has been reviewed.

## Step 2: Approve the candidate

Choose **Step 2: Approve annual report candidate**. Identify the authorised
approver and complete the candidate, disclosure and readiness confirmations.
Step 2 approves the annual report and companion update together. It copies the
exact five-file payload into `public_ready`, writes
`public_manifest.csv`, and writes `approval.yml` last. It does not rebuild or
publish the report.

## Step 3: Publish the approved report

Choose **Step 3: Publish approved annual report** for the same year and version.
Step 3 reads only `public_ready`. Confirm successful verification and inspect
the authoritative public report package, both website PDF mirrors, both landing
pages and the shared metadata. Confirm that the public-health update appears in
the CVD report listing and in **Latest outputs** after the Quarto site is
rendered.

A correction uses a higher approved version at the same stable period location.
The superseded working-tree report is recoverable through Git history; do not
retain parallel public copies or edit the generated PDF manually.
